verdict.rationale: Rive documents a built-in AI agent in the Editor that generates scripts, layouts, data models and animation. It also documents an MCP connection that lets AI tools perform editor tasks like building State Machines and View Models. The docs never explicitly describe typing natural-language commands or show which editor operations can be driven by prompt, and nothing independent corroborates it, so coverage is partial rather than complete. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language command input and its scope across editor operations, hands-on or independent corroboration of agent reliability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Rive's AI agent helps you write code, design, and animate. Generate scripts, responsive layouts, data models, and even animation.
The first set of tools are designed to let AI handle repetitive tasks, like creating complex View Models, State Machines with hundreds of states/layers, Layouts, Shapes, and more.
